subproblem.title: Simon 7.3.3(2), corrected (13): a point flat at arbitrarily small scales has a tangent plane
subproblem.statement: For all n, k, ℓ ∈ ℕ with ℓ ≤ k and n ≥ 1, all sets U, N ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} and every T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) such that U is open, N is an embedded C² (n+ℓ)-dimensional submanifold (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 (n + ℓ) N), (closure N ∖ N) ∩ U = ∅, T is minimizing in U ∩ N (IsMinimizingIn T (U ∩ N)), spt T ⊆ U ∩ N and ∂T = 0 in U (BoundaryVanishes T), and every x ∈ spt T: if x is flat at arbitrarily small scales, i.e. for every β > 0 and every R > 0 there are ρ with 0 < ρ < R and an n-dimensional linear subspace Q ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} such that |(y − x) − p_Q(y − x)| < βρ for every y ∈ spt T with |y − x| < ρ (p_Q the orthogonal projection onto Q, Lean `Q.starProjection`), then T has a tangent plane at x (HasTangentPlaneAt T x: some tangent cone C of T at x, a ConvergesWeakly-limit of blowUp T x λ_j with λ_j > 0, λ_j → 0, has support an n-dimensional linear subspace).
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (n k ℓ : ℕ), ℓ ≤ k → ∀ (U N : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), 1 ≤ n → IsOpen U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 (n + ℓ) N → (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → IsMinimizingIn T (U ∩ N) → T.support ⊆ U ∩ N → BoundaryVanishes T → ∀ x ∈ T.support, (∀ β : ℝ, 0 < β → ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ρ < R ∧ ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid (n + k)), Module.finrank ℝ Q = n ∧ ∀ y ∈ T.support, dist y x < ρ → ‖(y - x) - Q.starProjection (y - x)‖ < β * ρ) → HasTangentPlaneAt T x
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: parent step 8 (Simon 7.3.3(2), corrected (13): a point in ∩_j R_{β_j}(T) has a tangent plane), case ρ_∞ = 0; the hypothesis provides flatness at scales tending to 0, so the case ρ_∞ > 0 of the parent's step 8 does not arise. P := n + k. For an integer multiplicity current A on an open set, μ_A denotes the measure R.measure of any representation R of A (all representations have the same measure), M_W(A) = μ_A(W) for open W inside the domain of A, and spt A = {x in the domain : μ_A(B_ε(x)) > 0 for every ε > 0} (sibling result im_mass_measure (c), (a), (b), `Submission.dimred_im_mass_measure`); Θ_A := Θ^n(μ_A, ·); ω_n := unitBallVolume n; η_{y,λ}(w) := λ^{−1}(w − y), so blowUp T y λ = η_{y,λ#}T ∈ 𝒟_n(η_{y,λ}(U)); H^n := μHE[n] = c_nμH[n] with c_n ∈ (0, ∞) (Mathlib `euclideanHausdorffMeasure_def`, `addHaarScalarFactor_volume_hausdorffMeasure_ne_zero`), so H^n and μH[n] have the same null sets. Mass scaling of blow-ups: M_{η_{y,λ}(W)}(η_{y,λ#}T) = λ^{−n}M_W(T) for λ > 0 (Simon 6.2.23; the accepted `Submission.dtc_blowUp_massOn_image`). B_ρ(x) is the open ball.
1. (Setup.) Since n ≥ 1 and ∂T = 0, boundarySupport T = spt 0 = ∅, so x ∈ spt T ∖ boundarySupport T. By the sibling result monotonicity (`Submission.dimred_minimizing_monotonicity`, d := n + ℓ), every θ with HasMassDensity T x θ satisfies θ ≥ 1. For a subspace Q write p_Q for the orthogonal projection onto Q (Lean `Q.starProjection`) and q_Q := id − p_Q (the projection onto Q^⊥).
2. (Flat scales.) For each j ∈ ℕ apply the hypothesis with β := 2^{−j} and R := 1/(j + 1): there are ρ_j ∈ (0, 1/(j + 1)) and an n-dimensional subspace Q_j with |q_{Q_j}(y − x)| < 2^{−j}ρ_j for every y ∈ spt T with |y − x| < ρ_j.
3. (Convergence of the planes.) Choose orthonormal bases (v_{j,1}, …, v_{j,n}) of Q_j. By compactness of the unit sphere of ℝ^P, pass to a strictly increasing sequence j(i) along which v_{j(i),l} → v_l for l = 1, …, n; (v_1, …, v_n) is orthonormal; let Q := span{v_1, …, v_n}, so dim Q = n. Since p_{Q_j}(u) = Σ_l⟨u, v_{j,l}⟩v_{j,l}, |p_{Q_{j(i)}}(u) − p_Q(u)| ≤ 2|u|Σ_l|v_{j(i),l} − v_l| =: |u|κ_i with κ_i → 0; hence |q_{Q_{j(i)}}(u) − q_Q(u)| ≤ |u|κ_i.
4. (Tangent cone.) Apply density_and_tangent_cones (2) (`Submission.density_and_tangent_cones`) at x ∈ spt T ∖ boundarySupport T to the scales λ_i := ρ_{j(i)} > 0, λ_i → 0: there are a strictly increasing φ and C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with blowUp T x λ_{φ(i)} ⇀ C (ConvergesWeakly), C minimizing in ℝ^P, C a cone (IsConeCurrent C), and θ with HasMassDensity T x θ and HasMassDensity C 0 θ; by (1), θ ≥ 1. Write σ_i := λ_{φ(i)} = ρ_{j(φ(i))}, Q'_i := Q_{j(φ(i))}, κ'_i := κ_{φ(i)} → 0; note j(φ(i)) ≥ i, so the tilt 2^{−j(φ(i))} ≤ 2^{−i}.
5. (∂C = 0.) Write n = n' + 1 and let ω ∈ 𝒟^{n'}(ℝ^P). The compact set tsupport dω ⊆ tsupport ω lies in the domain η_{x,σ_i}(U) of blowUp T x σ_i for all large i (x ∈ U, U open, σ_i → 0). The blow-up commutes with the boundary (η_{x,σ} is a proper affine diffeomorphism; Simon 6.2.23, GeometricCurrentOn.boundary_affinePushforward; accepted `Submission.dtc_blowUp_algebra`): ∂(blowUp T x σ_i) = blowUp (∂T) x σ_i = 0. Hence currentEval(blowUp T x σ_i, dω) = (blowUp T x σ_i)(dω) = ∂(blowUp T x σ_i)(ω) = 0 for large i, and C(dω) = lim_i currentEval(blowUp T x σ_i, dω) = 0. So ∂C = 0 (BoundaryVanishes C).
6. (Supports of the blow-ups.) spt(blowUp T x σ) = η_{x,σ}(spt T) (accepted `Submission.dtc_blowUp_algebra`; a test form is supported in an open W' iff its pullback by the affine diffeomorphism η_{x,σ} is supported in η_{x,σ}^{−1}(W'), so the zero regions correspond). Hence if u ∈ spt(blowUp T x σ_i) and |u| < 1, then y := x + σ_iu ∈ spt T with |y − x| < σ_i = ρ_{j(φ(i))}, and by (2), |q_{Q'_i}(u)| = σ_i^{−1}|q_{Q'_i}(y − x)| < 2^{−j(φ(i))} ≤ 2^{−i}.
7. (spt C ∩ B_1(0) ⊆ Q.) Let v ∈ ℝ^P with |v| < 1 and q_Q(v) ≠ 0; put δ := |q_Q(v)|/2 > 0 and δ' := min(δ, (1 − |v|)/2). For u ∈ B_{δ'}(v): |u| < 1, |q_Q(u)| ≥ 2δ − δ' ≥ δ, and |q_{Q'_i}(u)| ≥ δ − κ'_i > 2^{−i} for all large i. By (6), B_{δ'}(v) ∩ spt(blowUp T x σ_i) = ∅ for all large i. For such i, B_{δ'}(v) lies in the domain of blowUp T x σ_i (for large i), every test form supported in B_{δ'}(v) has support disjoint from spt(blowUp T x σ_i), so blowUp T x σ_i vanishes on it (a current vanishes on test forms whose support misses its support; accepted `Submission.dtc_vanish_off_support`), and therefore M_{B_{δ'}(v)}(blowUp T x σ_i) = 0. The sibling child weak_limit_mass_bound (W := B_{δ'}(v), B := 0) gives M_{B_{δ'}(v)}(C) = 0. Then C(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(ℝ^P) with tsupport ω ⊆ B_{δ'}(v) (if s := sup|ω| > 0, both ±ω/s are admissible for M_{B_{δ'}(v)}(C), so ±C(ω) ≤ 0). As B_{δ'}(v) is open with compact closure, it lies in the zero region of C, so v ∉ spt C.
8. (spt C ⊆ Q.) C is a cone: for λ > 0 and ω ∈ 𝒟^n(ℝ^P), C(ω) = currentEval(blowUp C 0 λ, ω) = C(η_{0,λ}^#ω), where tsupport η_{0,λ}^#ω = λ·tsupport ω. Hence if C vanishes on all test forms supported in an open set W', it vanishes on all test forms supported in λW' (apply the identity with λ^{−1}), so the zero region and the support of C are invariant under w ↦ λw (λ > 0). If v ∈ spt C, pick λ > 2|v|; then λ^{−1}v ∈ spt C ∩ B_1(0) ⊆ Q by (7), so v ∈ Q.
9. (Constancy.) C is integer multiplicity (being minimizing), ∂C = 0 by (5), spt C ⊆ Q by (8), and ℝ^P ∩ Q = Q is connected. By the sibling child planar_constancy (`Submission.idtp_planar_cycle_eq_const_mul`, with V := ℝ^P and τ := (v_1, …, v_n), an orthonormal basis of Q) there is c ∈ ℤ with M_W(C) = |c|·H^n(W ∩ Q) for every open W ⊆ ℝ^P; put m := |c| ∈ ℕ. Since HasMassDensity C 0 θ with θ ≥ 1, M_{B_ρ(0)}(C) > 0 for small ρ > 0, so m ≥ 1.
10. (spt C = Q.) Let v ∈ Q and ε > 0: M_{B_ε(v)}(C) = m·H^n(B_ε(v) ∩ Q) = mω_nε^n > 0 (μHE[n] on Q is the isometric image of Lebesgue measure). If v ∉ spt C, then v lies in an open set W' with compact closure on which C vanishes; for ε small, B_ε(v) ⊆ W', so every form admissible for M_{B_ε(v)}(C) is supported in W' and M_{B_ε(v)}(C) = 0, a contradiction. Hence Q ⊆ spt C, and with (8), spt C = Q.
11. (Conclusion.) The scales lams i := σ_i > 0 tend to 0 and blowUp T x σ_i ⇀ C, so IsTangentConeAt T x C; and spt C = Q with dim Q = n. Hence HasTangentPlaneAt T x. ∎
proof_key_steps: Choose flat scales ρ_j < 1/(j+1) with tilt 2^{−j} and planes Q_j; by compactness of orthonormal frames, Q_j → Q along a subsequence.
density_and_tangent_cones (2) along these scales gives a minimizing cone C with blowUp T x ρ_j ⇀ C and density θ ≥ 1 at 0.
∂C = 0 because blow-ups of the cycle T are cycles.
The blow-ups' supports in B_1(0) lie in thinning slabs around Q_j; weak_limit_mass_bound gives spt C ∩ B_1(0) ⊆ Q, and the cone property gives spt C ⊆ Q.
planar_constancy gives M_W(C) = m·H^n(W ∩ Q) with m = |c| ≥ 1, so spt C = Q and T has a tangent plane at x.

audit.reason: The exact flatness hypothesis supplies scales tending to zero. Frame compactness and tangent-cone existence yield a nonzero cycle; weak mass bounds confine its support to the limiting plane. Planar constancy proves equality of supports, furnishing precisely HasTangentPlaneAt.
